name: Mardia Samyoung Capillary Tubes Company Ltd

facts.business: Mardia Samyoung Capillary Tubes Company Limited is engaged in the sale of goods, specifically capillary tubes.

auditor.name: M/s. S K Bhavsar & Co., Chartered Accountant
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matters: 1) Management did not furnish balance confirmation letters, party-wise reconciliation statements, and age-wise analysis for certain Trade Receivable and Trade Payable balances as at 31st March 2026, so auditors unable to satisfy themselves on existence, completeness, accuracy, and recoverability; impact not ascertainable. 2) Satisfactory supporting documents not provided for completeness of valuation of inventory as on 31st March 2026. 3) Company has not appointed an Internal Auditor for the entire Financial Year 2025-26, constituting non-compliance with Section 138 of Companies Act, 2013. 4) Company has significant trade payables (text truncated).

key_risks: Non-compliance with SEBI (PIT) Regulations, 2015 regarding Trading Window Closure for quarter ended March 2025
Non-submission of XBRL regarding prior intimation of Board Meeting for quarter ended March 31, 2025
Non-publication of advertisement in newspaper within 48 hours of board meeting conclusion for quarters ended March 31, 2025 and June 30, 2025
Non-submission of SDD Compliance Certificate for quarter ended March 31, 2025
Non-submission of Closure of Trading Window in PDF & XBRL mode for period ended June 30, 2025
Non-submission of Certificate under Regulation 74(5) of SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018 for quarter ended June 30, 2025
Delay in submission of XBRL of Change in Management announcement dated May 25, 2026
Delay in appointment of Qualified Company Secretary as Compliance Officer
Absence of Internal Auditor for entire FY 2025-26, resulting in significant gap in internal control framework
Lack of balance confirmations, reconciliations, and age-wise analysis for Trade Receivables and Trade Payables
Insufficient supporting documents for inventory valuation completeness
facts.related_party_note: All transactions entered with Related Parties for the year under review were at arm's length basis and in the ordinary course of business. Hence, provisions of Section 188 of the Companies Act, 2013 are not attracted. Disclosure in form AOC-2 is not required. Policy on Related Party Transactions available at https://mardiasygltd.com/.
